retirement_reason: R2 correctly repaired Lion's Eye Diamond multi-trigger behavior, but a subsequent pre-development audit found that Tidebinder lifecycle must be explicit: if Tidebinder leaves before its ETB resolves, the target ability is still countered but the source is not blanked; if Tidebinder later leaves, the blank ends; a countered Tidebinder spell creates no ETB.
critical_corrections: All R2 LED multi-trigger corrections remain required.
Tidebinder ETB counters its target even if Tidebinder leaves before the ETB resolves.
If Tidebinder leaves before its ETB resolves, Hashaton does not lose abilities.
If Tidebinder leaves after its ETB resolved and blanked Hashaton, Hashaton regains its printed abilities.
If Tidebinder spell itself is countered, it never enters and produces no ETB.
